description: This file contains shell script functions for managing firmware upgrades on GL.iNet devices using NAND and NOR flash memory, incorporating environment checks and partition management.

methods.name: glinet_using_boot_dev_switch
methods.description: Checks if the boot device switch is activated based on environment variable.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nand
methods.description: Sets the next boot to NAND by updating environment variables and creating lock files.

methods.name: glinet_set_next_boot_nor
methods.description: Sets the next boot to NOR via environment variables and lock files.

methods.name: glinet_nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs an upgrade process that involves setting the next boot to NAND or NOR.

methods.name: nand_nor_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function that determines firmware type and performs appropriate upgrade procedures for NAND or NOR devices.
